Name: Loafy's Little Ranch Farm
Author: loafeon
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]

﻿[list]
[*][size=2]Start out with a coop and barn! Includes [b]1 chick & 1 cow[/b]![/size]
[*][size=2]Blue grass and Regular grass grow here![/size]
[*][size=2]Catch Mountain, Town, and Forest fish from the ranch dock[/size]
[*][size=2]Enjoy mixed seed weeds & Forest foraging[/size]
[*][size=2]Special farmhouse furniture layout![/size]
[*][size=2]Hidden Greenhouse[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]


﻿
[list]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13804]Custom Farm Loader[/url]﻿ [/size]
[*][size=2]Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[i]*I suggest utilizing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16873]Easy Farm Switcher[/url] for prior save files*[/i]
[/size]﻿
